mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS increases (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it signals an overheating labor market that may trigger aggressive Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong economy that may lead to recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal does not materialize when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls (SPX 20-day returns positive in >40% of cases) or Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%), a Federal Funds rate above 4.0% indicates aggressive monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, which supports economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST increases (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 7.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to raise rates aggressively, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 7.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust economic activity, which typically boosts corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO increases (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that may reduce consumer spending and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1400 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years below 0.03.
